after: The game contains two enemy types:
- Normal Enemy: requires 1 player-bullet hit to defeat and awards 10 points.
- Armored Enemy: requires 2 player-bullet hits to defeat and awards 20 points when defeated.
Armored Enemies appear at fixed positions in each wave and are visually distinguishable from Normal Enemies.

before: Enemies are represented by purple circles. Each enemy:
- Uses a 30 × 30 px bounding rectangle for collision detection.
- Is treated as an independent target.
after: All enemies use a 30 × 30 px bounding rectangle for collision detection and are treated as independent targets.
- Have the same 30 px diameter and 30 × 30 px collision rectangle.
- Are represented using a darker purple circle, a visible outline, or another clearly distinguishable visual treatment.
Armored Enemy positions use `(row, col)` within the formation, with rows and columns numbered starting from 1.
All other positions contain Normal Enemies.
Both Normal and Armored Enemies may be selected to fire.

before: Wave 1 begins as a 2 × 6 formation at `(120, 110)`.
after: Wave 1 begins as a 2 × 6 formation at `(120, 110)` with Armored Enemies at `(1,2)` and `(1,5)`.

before: The game then resolves player bullet–enemy collisions and enemy bullet–player collisions. Defeated enemies are removed and award 10 points each. Valid enemy bullet hits reduce Lives according to the 1-second invulnerability rule.
after: The game then resolves player bullet–enemy collisions and enemy bullet–player collisions.
Normal Enemies are defeated after one valid player-bullet hit and award 10 points.
Armored Enemies require two valid player-bullet hits. The first hit reduces HP from 2 to 1 without awarding score; the second reduces HP from 1 to 0, removes the enemy, and awards 20 points.

before: If Wave 1 or Wave 2 is cleared, all bullets are removed and the next wave begins while Score, Lives, and player horizontal position are preserved.
after: If Wave 1 or Wave 2 is cleared, all bullets are removed and the next fixed wave begins with all of its Normal and Armored Enemies at full HP while Score, Lives, and player horizontal position are preserved.

before: Each defeated enemy increases Score by 10. Wave completion provides no bonus score.
after: Normal Enemies require one hit and award 10 points when defeated.
Armored Enemies are visually distinguishable, require two hits, award no score after the first hit, and award 20 points when defeated.
